$comment: Feature catalog for the alternative-designs survey. `areas` are the brief's baseline everyone was measured on; `extras` are capabilities other entrants shipped that Cicero did not when the field was read on 2026-08-16, each attributed to the project slugs in projects.json — an extra Cicero has built since carries `ciceroShipped` with the pull request that closed it, and is never silently deleted; `ciceroDifferentiators` are Cicero capabilities counted absent across the analyzed field. Hand-maintained — `bun run alternatives:build` validates every attribution against projects.json.

areas.label: CFP intake
areas.description: Public proposal submission: form definition, open/close windows, drafts, edits, withdrawal, confirmation.

areas.label: Review rounds & scoring
areas.description: Reviewer assignment, rubrics and weighted criteria, rounds, score capture, round outcomes.

areas.label: Anonymized review
areas.description: Speaker identity withheld from reviewers where the round is configured anonymous, enforced server-side.

areas.label: Decisions & notifications
areas.description: Accept/reject/waitlist transitions and the notices they generate.

areas.label: Agenda / scheduling
areas.description: Rooms, tracks, timeslots, placement of accepted sessions, publication of the program.

areas.label: Conflict detection
areas.description: Room and speaker double-booking surfaced before or at publication.

areas.label: Speaker portal & tasks
areas.description: Authenticated speaker surface for profile, assignments, and assigned tasks.

areas.label: Content deliverables
areas.description: Requested files (slides, headshots, bios) with upload, approval, and revision handling.

areas.label: Comms / templates
areas.description: Reusable message templates, merge fields, audience resolution, delivery and retry.

areas.label: Public event pages
areas.description: Published agenda, session, and speaker pages for attendees.

areas.label: Embeddable widgets
areas.description: Agenda/speaker views embeddable in an external site.

areas.label: Public REST API
areas.description: Versioned HTTP API over program data for external consumers.

areas.label: AI features
areas.description: Any model-backed capability reachable by a user.

areas.label: Speaker CRM
areas.description: Cross-event speaker/contact directory beyond a single event's submissions.

areas.label: Sponsors
areas.description: Sponsor or exhibitor entities, intake, and public partner surfaces.

extras.title: Whole-event cloning / reusable event templates
extras.description: Copy forms, tracks, rooms, scorecards, task and message templates, and optionally the team, into a new event. Several implementations preview the copy before applying, and deliberately exclude operational history.

ciceroShipped.note: `lib/services/event-clone.ts` plans a structure-only clone and `app/organizer/duplicate/` previews it before applying; people and operational history are deliberately excluded.

extras.title: Speaker availability / blackout windows as a scheduling constraint
extras.description: Collected during CFP or in the portal as dates, times, or dayparts, then surfaced as explicit conflicts against the agenda. Cicero detects room and speaker double-booking but has no concept of a speaker being unavailable at a time they were never scheduled.

ciceroShipped.note: A `speaker_unavailability` window declared in the portal is read by `lib/services/speaker-availability.ts` and enforced through the same agenda guard as double-booking.

extras.title: Richer embed output formats
extras.description: JSON, XML, subscribable iCalendar, and script-loader snippets emitted from the same widget configuration, alongside the iframe. This confirms a gap we had already recorded against ourselves.

ciceroShipped.note: `app/embed/[slug]/[view]/[format]/route.ts` renders one widget configuration as `feed.json`, `feed.xml` and a subscribable `feed.ics` off the same query string the iframe and script snippets carry.

extras.title: Revision history with organizer restore
extras.description: Attributed, numbered snapshots of proposal and session titles/abstracts that an organizer can roll back.

ciceroShipped.note: Mis-scored at survey time: `lib/services/content.ts` already recorded, listed, diffed and restored revisions. #200 added the monotonic revision number this item names, plus agenda and sponsor coverage.

extras.title: Bidirectional Airtable sync
extras.description: Cicero's Airtable integration is one-way. Others reconcile in both directions with field ownership, conflict handling, retries, and dead letters.

extras.title: Authentication beyond magic links
extras.description: Cicero is magic-link-only by design (`T-4a`); five teams read the brief as permitting more.

extras.title: Real-time collaborative agenda over Durable Objects + WebSockets
extras.description: A per-event Cloudflare Durable Object serializes schedule writes and broadcasts invalidations, so several operators can drag the grid at once.

extras.title: In-product streaming AI assistant with tool use
extras.description: A chat surface inside the organizer app that drives the same tool registry the MCP server exposes, with persisted threads and an approval step before mutations. Cicero's AI is advisory-only and out-of-band.

extras.title: Tokenized no-login share links
extras.description: Expiring, revocable links that expose a proposal, deliverable, or report to someone without an account.

ciceroShipped.note: `lib/services/share-links.ts` issues expiring, revocable, prefix-indexed links over the six programme views in `lib/share-link-views.ts`, so an unpublished programme can be reviewed without an account.

extras.title: OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP
extras.description: dynamic registration, PKCE, consent, discovery, refresh rotation. Cicero's MCP is token-scoped without an authorization-code flow.

extras.title: Per-event `llms.txt`
extras.description: generated from current public state, for AI agents reading the event.

ciceroShipped.note: `app/(public)/[slug]/llms.txt/route.ts` generates a per-event file from current published state, alongside the site-level `app/llms.txt`.

extras.title: Accelevents integration
extras.description: with preview/apply diffs against a real external event platform.

extras.title: Organization-level team administration
